title: Well-posedness for the generalised fractional BBM equation
summary: In this paper, we study a generalised family of fractional BBM equations on the $d$ dimensional torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ for $d\geq 1$. We establish low regularity local and global well-posedness results on the $H^s(\mathbb{T}^d)$ scale that improve upon the works of Bona and Chen (2003) and Kim and Kwak (2026). We also prove endpoint global well-posedness for the cubic regularised Benjamin-Ono equation in $H^{1/2}(\mathbb{T})$.
